t: Handsaw blade with thin-kerf teeth and Titanium Cobalt Carbide (TiCo) for a sharper edge, flawless finish and longer cutting life. Suitable for cutting fibre cement and plasterboard. Features polycrystalline diamond teeth for tough applications, anti-vibration slots for smooth running and minimised noise, tri-metal shock-resistant brazing alloy to withstand extreme impact and premium steel body for precision and endurance. Laser-marking on each blade shows relevant applications for easy and immediate identification.
b: Suitable for cutting Fibre Cement & Drywall Boards
For use with Circular & Plunge Saws
